data.one_liner: A Markdown renderer widget for Flutter to display rich text from plain text data.
data.what_it_does: Parses Markdown strings into an abstract syntax tree and renders them into rich text Flutter widgets. Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown features like tables, task lists, code blocks, links, and images.
use_when: You need to render Markdown-formatted text inside a Flutter application.
You require customizable text styling, custom element builders, or text selection for Markdown content.
avoid_when: You need native inline HTML rendering inside your Markdown source.
You are not displaying text-based documents or content.
strengths: Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown, tables, task lists, and footnotes out of the box.
Provides multiple widget options for scrollable views, embedded bodies, and unstyled raw output.
weaknesses: Does not support inline HTML inside Markdown source text.
Requires manual handling for opening URLs when links are tapped.
